Mali.title: Mali: 900 Tankers Under Escort - What Africa Corps Actually Does in Mali
Mali.summary: On September 14, 2026, more than 900 fuel tankers entered Bamako under military escort, the Malian government announced. The figure sounds like a victory: the capital got its fuel. But the very need to herd 900 tankers into a single protected convoy is not a story about victory -- it is a story about how vulnerable the ordinary roads have become, the same roads through which Mali imports 95% of its fuel.

Mali.title: Kidal: Colonel Attaher Maiga and his men at the heart of the FAMa's takeover and securing of the city
Mali.summary: Kidal: Colonel Attaher Maïga, from the "red beret" to the command of the FAMa to consolidate the presence of the Malian State The truth of the weapons and the terrain prevailed over the opposing propaganda: Kidal is definitively and fully released, secured and reinstated in the bosom of the Republic of Mali . Colonel Attaher Maiga In the aftermath of this decisive step taken by the Malian Armed Forces (FAMa), it is a poignant testimony, full of assurance, authority and patriotism, delivered by Colonel Attaher A.

Mali.title: Operation Dougoukoloko: the FAMa intensify their air-land operations in the Talhandak, Kidal and Tessalit sectors
Mali.summary: Bamako, 7 October 2026 – The Malian Armed Forces (FAMa) are resolutely continuing their missions to monitor, control and secure the national territory as part of Operation Dougoukoloko According to the information provided by the General Staff of the Armed Forces, several aero-terrestrial actions were carried out on Wednesday, October 7, 2026 in different sectors of the Eastern Theater, in particular in the Talhandak areas, north of Kidal and in the Tessalit region .
